צח.en: The first of them is on the definition of reflection and its true nature.

pairs.en: is on the definition of reflection

צח.ja: ואלת'אני הל ילזמנא אלאעתבאר באלמכ'לוקין אם לא.
צח.en: The second: whether reflection upon the created things is incumbent upon us or not.

pairs.en: whether reflection upon the created things is incumbent upon us

צח.en: The third: in what way is reflection upon the created things to be done.

צח.ja: ואלראבע כם צנוף אלחכמה פי אלמכ'לוקין אלתי ימכננא אלאעתבאר בהא.
צח.en: The fourth: how many kinds of wisdom there are in the created things by which it is possible for us to reflect.

pairs.en: how many kinds of wisdom there are
by which it is possible for us to reflect

צח.ja: ואלכ'אמס אי אלצנוף אקרב מנא ואוג'ב עלינא אלאעתבאר בה מן סאירהא.
צח.en: The fifth: which of the kinds is nearest to us and most obligatory upon us to reflect upon, more than the rest of them.

pairs.en: which of the kinds is nearest to us
and most obligatory upon us to reflect upon
more than the rest of them

צח.en: The sixth: on the things that spoil reflection and what follows from them.

pairs.en: on the things that spoil reflection

צח.ja: קאל, ואמא מאהיהֵ אלאעתבאר, פהו אלתפהם לאת'אר חכמהֵ אללה ג'ל ועז פי אלמכ'לוקין, ותקדירהא פי אלנפס חסב קוהֵ תמייז אלמעתבר.
צח.en: He said: As for the definition of reflection — it is the comprehension of the traces of God's wisdom (mighty and exalted) in the created things, and the registering of these in the soul according to the strength of the reflecting man's discernment.

pairs.en: As for the definition of reflection
of the traces of God's wisdom (mighty and exalted)
and the registering of these in the soul
according to the strength of the reflecting man's discernment

צח.ja: וד'לך אן אלחכמה ואן אכ'תלפת את'ארהא פי אלמכ'לוקין פהי ואחדה פי אסהא ואצלהא,
צח.en: For wisdom — though its traces vary in the created things — is one in its root and its source.

pairs.en: in its root and its source

צח.ja: כאלשמס אלתי הי ואחדה פי ד'אתהא ותכ'תלף אלואן שעאעהא פי אלשמסאת אלתי תצנע מן אלזג'אג' אלאביץ' ואלאכ'צ'ר ואלאסוד ואלאחמר, פיכ'תלף צ'והא עלי חסב אכ'תלאף אלואן אלזג'אג'.
צח.en: It is like the sun, which is one in itself, but the colors of its ray differ in the panes of glass that are made of white glass, of green, of black, of red — so that its light differs according to the differences in the colors of the glass.

pairs.en: but the colors of its ray differ
that are made of white glass
of green, of black, of red
according to the differences in the colors of the glass

צח.ja: וכאלמא אלד'י יסקי בה אלריאץ' פכת'רג' אלנואויר אלמכ'תלפהֵ אלאלואן פיתלוון פיהא בחסב ד'לך.
צח.en: And like the water by which the gardens are watered: it brings forth the flowers, differing in color, so that the water itself takes on color according to them.

pairs.en: by which the gardens are watered
so that the water itself takes on color according to them

צח.ja: פאפהם ען מכ'לוקאת אלבארי ג'ל ועז דקיקהא וג'לילהא, ותרדד פימא כ'פי ענך מנהא תג'דהא עלי מא וצפת אן שא אללה.
צח.en: So understand, regarding the created things of the Maker (mighty and exalted) — both the small among them and the great — and consider attentively what is hidden from you of them, and you will find them as I have described, God willing.

pairs.en: regarding the created things of the Maker (mighty and exalted)
both the small among them and the great
and consider attentively what is hidden from you of them
and you will find them as I have described

צח.ja: ומן אג'ל אכ'תלאפהא פי אלמכ'לוקין לזמנא אלתפהם להא ואלתפכר פיהא חתי יחצל מענאהא פי נפוסנא ויסתקר פי אוהאמנא.
צח.en: It is on account of the difference of these traces in the created things that the comprehension and reflection upon them have been laid upon us — until their concept becomes established within our souls and settles in our imaginations.

pairs.en: It is on account of the difference of these traces
that the comprehension and reflection upon them have been laid upon us
until their concept becomes established within our souls

צח.ja: ולו כאנת את'ארהא ואחדה פי ג'מיע אלמכ'לוקין לם ישתבה עלי אחד אמרהא, ואסתוי אלעאקל ואלג'אהל פי אלתמייז ענהא, ואלעלה
צח.en: For if the traces of wisdom were uniform throughout all created things, no one would be in doubt regarding their matter, and the man of intellect and the ignorant would be equal in discerning them; and the cause

pairs.en: For if the traces of wisdom were uniform
no one would be in doubt regarding their matter
and the man of intellect and the ignorant would be equal
